summary: Eduardo Telles’s Octopus With Pajamas covers gi sweeps and back takes from half, closed, butterfly and reverse half guard.
description: A compact gi octopus course with sleeve entries, sweep variations and counters.
overview: Octopus With Pajamas presents Eduardo Telles’s gi approach in one volume. Sweeps and back takes recur across several starting guards, including a closed-guard sleeve entry. The course also covers counters using kata gatame and Ezekiel before closing with reverse-half options.

guide.display_title: Eduardo Telles: Octopus Guard in the Gi

fits: You want a compact gi course focused on octopus sweeps and back takes from several guards.

includes: Half-guard and butterfly sweeps, closed-guard sleeve entries, hip bumps and back takes.
Counters to octopus and reverse-half sweeps and back takes.
limits: Its single volume is concentrated on gi guard exchanges; headlock and turtle offense are not developed into separate volumes.

flashcards.question: Can a sleeve-dependent octopus entry be copied unchanged into no-gi?
flashcards.answer: No. The sleeve connection requires a gi; the published Telles outline explicitly includes a closed-guard sleeve entry.
flashcards.answer_line: No: the sleeve grip requires a gi.
